<script setup>
import { ref, provide } from 'vue'
import Header from './components/Header.vue'
import ProductList from './components/ProductList.vue'
import Cart from './components/Cart.vue'
import Modal from './components/Modal.vue'
import CheckoutForm from './components/CheckoutForm.vue'

const { products } = defineProps({
  products: { type: Array, required: true },
})

provide('currency', 'USD')

const checkoutOpen = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <Header @checkout="checkoutOpen = true" />
  <ProductList :products="products" />
  <Cart />
  <Modal v-if="checkoutOpen" @close="checkoutOpen = false">
    <CheckoutForm @submitted="checkoutOpen = false" />
  </Modal>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, onUnmounted } from 'vue'

const emit = defineEmits(['search'])
const query = ref('')
let timer

function onInput() {
  clearTimeout(timer)
  timer = setTimeout(() => emit('search', query.value), 300)
}

onUnmounted(() => clearTimeout(timer))
</script>

<template>
  <input v-model="query" type="search" placeholder="Search products" @input="onInput" />
</template>
